coverage_exempt.reason: Original disassembly proves this repeated missing-palette arm cannot execute: conversion with context depth 8 and absent context+0x878 already exits at 0x4bde14; reaching 0x4bde8c retains the same context and field with no intervening call or store.
Original-only null-operator-new witness faults on the unconditional surface vtable load at 0x4bc7aa reading address zero. This two-byte null assignment arm cannot complete a valid original execution.
